title: GreenComputingPaperStuff
summary: A research codebase for a green/fog computing paper, containing model training scripts, dataset generation code, and a custom simulator similar to iFogSim. Its dataset generation script trains and compares four SDV single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, GaussianCopula) with SingleTableMetadata to generate a synthetic 'Padma' dataset.
evidence: generate_padma_dataset_v5.py:243-248 trains CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on seed data
